_meta.indication: NEXLETOL is indicated as an adjunct to diet and maximally tolerated statin therapy for the treatment of adults with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia or established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease who require additional lowering of LDL-C.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 52-week trial; randomization 2:1, stratified by HeFH status and baseline statin intensity
pivotal_trials.population: Secondary prevention: High CV risk (ASCVD and/or HeFH) on maximally tolerated statin who require additional LDL-C lowering
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary: percent change from baseline to Week 12 in LDL-C
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted LDL-C percent change from baseline at Week 12: -18.7% (95% CI -20.5, -16.9)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥2% and greater than placebo) include upper respiratory tract infection (4.5% vs 4.0%), muscle spasms (3.6% vs 2.3%), hyperuricemia (3.5% vs 1.1%), and elevated liver enzymes (2.1% vs 0.8%). Warnings include hyperuricemia and tendon rupture (0.5% vs 0%).
target_moa: Bempedoic acid is an inhibitor of adenosine triphosphate-citrate lyase (ACL), an enzyme upstream of HMG-CoA reductase in the cholesterol biosynthesis pathway; it is a prodrug converted to ETC-1002-CoA in the liver, reducing hepatic cholesterol synthesis and upregulating LDL receptors to lower LDL-C.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened (Advisory Committee Summary: N/A).

description.text: Added indication to reduce risk of myocardial infarction and coronary revascularization in statin-intolerant adults with established CVD or high CVD risk

citations.quote:
Nexletol is indicated to reduce the risk of myocardial infarction and coronary revascularization in adults who are unable to take recommended statin therapy (including those not taking a statin) with:established cardiovascular disease (CVD), or
- a high risk for a CVD event but without established CVD.

description.text: Revised the Indications and Usage statement for Nexletol (bempedoic acid)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for revision to the indication statement in Section 1 *Indications and Usage* of the Nexletol Prescribing information, minor revisions to other sections of the Prescribing Information to reflect the revised indication, and revisions to the Patient Package Insert.

summary.text: NEXLETOL was reviewed under a standard (not priority) review as an NDA received 2/21/2019 with a 2/20/2020 PDUFA goal date; it was approved based on two pivotal placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials demonstrating LDL-C lowering, with a post-marketing cardiovascular outcomes trial required.
